So 1 mile uses 8.2 / 62.137 = 0.132 L/mile. For 980 miles, liters needed = 0.132 * 980 = 129.36 L. Convert to gallons: 1 gallon = 3.78541 L. So gallons needed = 129.36 / 3.78541 = 34.18 gallons. But we already have 21 gallons. So need additional 13.18 gallons. Round up to integer: 14 gallons. But we might want to fill only enough to reach destination. So we need to add 14 gallons.
